passage.text: Ning is a nurse in Bangkok.
passage.reading: ˈnɪŋ ɪz ə ˈnɜːrs ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: "I listen to English podcasts every day on my way to work.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈlɪsən tu ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈpɑːdkæsts ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ ɑːn maɪ ˈweɪ tə ˈwɜːrk.

passage.text: When I started, I understood only a few words, but now I understand almost everything.
passage.reading: wɛn aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd, aɪ ˌʌndərˈstʊd ˈoʊnli ə ˈfjuː ˈwɜːrdz, bʌt ˈnaʊ aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛvriθɪŋ.

passage.text: My advice? Listen a little every day!"
passage.reading: maɪ ədˈvaɪs? ˈlɪsən ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ!

passage.text: Linh is a student from Vietnam.
passage.reading: ˈlɪn ɪz ə ˈstuːdənt frəm ˌviːɛtˈnɑːm.

passage.text: "I joined a language exchange at my university.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈdʒɔɪnd ə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ɪksˌtʃeɪndʒ ət maɪ ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

passage.text: I help a Canadian student with Vietnamese, and she helps me with English.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhɛlp ə kəˈneɪdiən ˈstuːdənt wɪð viˌɛtnəˈmiːz, ənd ʃiː ˈhɛlps miː wɪð ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

passage.text: We meet twice a week, and it's free!
passage.reading: wiː ˈmiːt ˈtwaɪs ə ˈwiːk, ənd ɪts ˈfriː!

passage.text: My advice? Make friends with English speakers!"
passage.reading: maɪ ədˈvaɪs? ˈmeɪk ˈfrɛndz wɪð ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈspiːkərz!

passage.text: Ken is a receptionist at a hotel in Phuket.
passage.reading: ˈkɛn ɪz ə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst ət ə hoʊˈtɛl ɪn puːˈkɛt.

passage.text: "I was always embarrassed about my accent, so I didn't speak much.
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈɔːlweɪz ɪmˈbærəst əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈæksɛnt, soʊ aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈspiːk ˈmʌtʃ.

passage.text: Then I decided to speak up in every meeting.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn aɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ˈspiːk ˈʌp ɪn ˈɛvri ˈmiːtɪŋ.

passage.text: Now my English is much better, and the guests love talking to me.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈmʌtʃ ˈbɛtər, ənd ðə ˈɡɛsts ˈlʌv ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə miː.

passage.text: My advice? Don't be shy. Speak up!"
passage.reading: maɪ ədˈvaɪs? ˈdoʊnt bi ˈʃaɪ. ˈspiːk ˈʌp!
